title: Wire promote-release.mjs to the shared release-provenance --post check
description: To Do. DO NOT START without plan approval. DEC-251 (a5): QCLI-555 AC3 was amended to say release.yml calls --post and the post-promotion check is the documented hand step. This task makes the promotion run it: after promote-release.mjs publishes the X launcher it should run the same tarball-route check (the bundle it already downloads, the qualification run id it already takes) rather than leaving it to a hand step. Separate from the (a3) preferred-route task, QCLI-556.

acceptanceCriteria.text: promote-release.mjs runs the shared release-provenance --post check against the X launcher it just published, using the bundle and run id it already holds
A promotion whose served X launcher is not the receipt-bound tarball fails, proved by a test, and a clean promotion passes
The runbook hand step for the post-promotion check is updated to say it is now automatic
